name: Metric
summary: A key figure with a label, and optionally its change.

favorable.description: Which direction is good, so color follows meaning, not sign

whenToUse: One to four headline numbers the user asked about
whenNotToUse: Many numbers: use Table or DetailList

requirements: Change direction is conveyed in text as well as color
Screen readers read label, value and change as one sentence

rendering: Change uses color.data.positive / negative according to 'favorable'

mappings.web: Card-like block with semantic tokens (no dedicated shadcn primitive)
mappings.ios: LabeledContent or a VStack; Gauge for bounded values
